BM25 filter with zero threshold passes all pages

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"bm25_query\":\"unrelated query\",\"bm25_threshold\":0.0,\"content_filter\":\"bm25\",\"max_depth\":1}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.crawl(engine: engineObj, url: url)
debugPrint(result.pages().count)
```
